xmldoc.short_description: Multiplies two matrix signals or applies element-wise multiplication.

description.p: The MatMul block has two inputs and one output. With MultiplicationRule set to matrix, it computes the matrix product A * B. With elementwise, it multiplies corresponding elements.
Matrix dimensions must be compatible with the selected rule. Scalars are expanded where the signal-layout rules allow it.
Code generation: supported for C and Rust.
